## 1.10.6 (2025-08-06)

🔗 Compare:
https://github.com/devalltect00/Custy/compare/1.10.5...1.10.6

**Release**
Stable

**Summary**

Final release of Custy 1.10.6.

This release focuses on workflow safety, merge validation, template improvements, and documentation.

Promoted from:

- 1.10.6rc4
- 1.10.6rc3
- 1.10.6rc2
- 1.10.6rc1
- 1.10.6b1

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Prevent unsafe execution when staged files exist.
- Added confirmation before continuing.
- Improved merge validation.

### 🧠 Improvements

- Safer tagging.
- Better merge logic.
- Better user prompts.

### 📄 Templates

- Expanded commit template.
- Expanded tag template.

### 📚 Documentation

- Updated project structure.

**Tags**

release • workflow • bugfix • docs • template • stable
